summary: Large government intelligence unit evaluating an on-prem, air-gapped RAG/search platform. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking at high scale (100M+ docs), strict zero-egress requirement, and procurement via DoD contracting vehicle. Cost sensitivity around per-query CPU/GPU spend; willing to invest in reserved capacity for predictable throughput.
technical_requirements: Indexing: 150M–300M documents (mixed formats PDF, DOCX, msg, databases)
Embeddings: offline batch generation + incremental delta updates; hardware: 8xA100-class or equivalent in customer datacenter
Vector store memory: pin high-recall shards on NVMe + RAM tiering
Reranking: model must be quantizable (<= 8-bit) with p99 end-to-end rerank latency < 450ms at 200 qps
Throughput/latency SLOs: median <120ms, p95 <300ms for hybrid search+embedding rerank flows
Cost targets: effective cost per high-recall query <$0.05 (amortized HW + software) when at scale
Offline and online fallback: small reranker model for low-cost fallback; automatic graceful degradation when load high
Packaging: air-gapped OVA/installer, signed binaries, offline license activation, documented upgrade path
Integrations: SAML SSO, existing AD groups, SIEM audit export (Splunk), HSM/KMS integration for key management
Compliance: CUI handling, FedRAMP-like controls desired, FIPS 140 validated crypto
notes:
